name: Robotics Lab
description: Explore how sensors, software and robotic systems work together. Ask your tour guide about practical projects and safe demonstrations. Do not touch equipment without permission.
positionNote: Reference point for The Hangar on the North Campus map, read at pixel 1117, 527; not a surveyed or GPS position. The Robotics Lab and Manufacturing Lab are both in The Hangar, so their pins are drawn side by side.

name: Manufacturing Lab
description: Discover the connection between design, technology and manufacturing. During your visit, ask how students develop and test prototypes. Follow staff instructions around machinery.
positionNote: Reference point for The Hangar on the North Campus map, read at pixel 1117, 527; not a surveyed or GPS position. The Robotics Lab and Manufacturing Lab are both in The Hangar, so their pins are drawn side by side.

name: Lecture Hall
summary: Step inside a collaborative learning space.
description: Explore the spaces where students discuss concepts, solve problems and present their work. Ask your guide about the student learning experience and classroom support.
positionNote: Lecture rooms are spread across the Main and North campus buildings, so this stop has no single map pin. Ask your guide which room your session is in.

name: Library
summary: Find your space to study and research.
description: Discover the study environment and ask staff about learning resources. Keep noise low, respect students who are studying and ask before taking photographs.
positionNote: Reference point read from the Library label on the supplied Main Campus map; not a surveyed or GPS position.

name: Student Lounge
summary: Get a feel for life beyond the classroom.
description: Explore a place to meet fellow students and take a break. Ask your guide about clubs, student leadership and campus activities that interest you.
positionNote: Reference point for the best-known Student Lounge on the Main Campus map, read at pixel 948, 1443; not a surveyed or GPS position. There are other student lounges on campus.
